foundation.skips: Platform-specific/native opt-in tests stay explicit; fourteen real installed slots supply the actual native qualification.

constitutional_review.I: Apache-2.0 application, complete separate notices and exact public corresponding sources; scoped artifact audits and upstream Windows acquisition.
constitutional_review.II: Standard library and existing inventory/qualification/promotion helpers reused; no production dependency added.
constitutional_review.III: Runtime selection/preparation isolated from graph domain and Graphviz process adapter; no algorithm redesign.
constitutional_review.IV: Pinned hashes and real normal catalog selected; corpus preserves original and semantics, atomic generations/recovery and fault tests.
constitutional_review.V: All fourteen ABI/Python slots, three installation formats and measured image/kernel/CPU; user visual acceptance bound to identical output hashes; no mock promoted.
constitutional_review.VI: Graphviz 16.1.0 preserved, existing Windows manifest/cache unchanged; entity substitution reproduced with modern source grants; minimal shared Server-build selection fix.

limitations: Distribution entries are compatibility declarations, not individual distro certification.
Windows tests used the actual hosted Server; no claim of clean Windows 11 certification.
Apple Developer ID/notarization are optional and not asserted; system protections unchanged.
Offline worker guard observes Python network operations, not a system-wide syscall trace; exact native artifacts were separately inspected.
Controlled download/disk/permission fault injection is identified in the recovery evidence.
